volume_zones.note: where volume traded in the last candles — a picture of the past, not a signal

supertrend.note: SuperCara — an ATR trend line: green below price in an uptrend, red above in a downtrend; flips when a bar closes through it

structure.swing_rule: The swing is the leg between the lowest swing low and the highest swing high confirmed within the last 200 candles; its retracement levels are measured back from where that leg ended.
structure.note: Where price last broke a swing high or low, the swing that would flip that, the retracement levels of the latest swing, and the bars that pushed past a swing but closed back inside it — marked for context, not a trade signal.

rule.buy_div: (WT_SHOW_DIV and (wt or wt_add)) or (STOCH_SHOW_DIV and stoch) or (RSI_SHOW_DIV and rsi)
rule.sell_div: (WT_SHOW_DIV and (wt or wt_add)) or (STOCH_SHOW_DIV and stoch) or (RSI_SHOW_DIV and rsi)
rule.buy_div_color: wt -> green; else wt_add -> green at +60 transparency; else RSI_SHOW_DIV (the SWITCH) -> green; else invisible (plotted, na colour)
rule.sell_div_color: wt -> red; else wt_add -> red at +60 transparency; else an rsi bear EVENT on that bar (whatever the switch) -> red; else invisible
